messages:
Ava: Quick proposal — shift weekly triage from 12:00pm PST to 12:10pm PST and trim to a 10m 'midday pocket' for quick bug triage + owner assignments. Goal: reduce overlap with product sync.
Rohit: What's the cadence? still weekly Wed?
Ava: Yep Wed 12:10-12:20 PST. We keep the current triage doc; just shorter. Also want to split queue into two lanes: hotfix (urgent) + backlog (triage+assign).
Maya: 12:10 PST is 8:10pm CET — I can do most weeks but prefer not during client calls on 3/24. Can we rotate owners so no one does it every week? :+1:
Chris: I can take week of 3/18 and 3/25. Prefer owner rotation 2 wks on/rotate?
Sofia: 2-week rotation seems heavy. How about 1 week on, 3 people pool? also can we add a 1-line agenda? e.g.
```agenda
- 0-4m: hotfix lane quick decisions
- 4-8m: backlog quick triage & assign
- 8-10m: followups / blockers
```
Rohit: can triage-bot post the pre-read (bug count + top 3 new sev2) 30m before? @triage-bot can we set that?
triage-bot: scheduled digest set for 30 minutes before Wed triage; will include counts and links.
Ava: Cool. Final q: does anyone want to keep the current 15m slot instead? If no objections by EOD Fri I'll switch the calendar.
Maya: No objections from me. :white_check_mark:
Chris: Fine with 10m as long as we have the pre-read. :thumbsup:
Sofia: OK. I'll update the triage owner rota doc and add the 3-person pool. ping me if you want to be added.
Ava: Thanks — I'll update the recurring event and announce in #eng. If a given week needs more time we'll spin up a followup 30-min deep dive.
Rohit: thanks all.
